title.narrative: Enhancing the capacity of the Ministry of Justice (Former Attorney General's Office) for Criminal Justice Reform

description.narrative: The overall objective of the grant is to increase respect for the rule of law and access to justice in the Ethiopian criminal justice system. The grant has two interconnected outcomes (specific objectives): Increased capacity for the implementation of reforms included in new laws and policies.Increased access to legal aid through the development of new legislation, the establishment of a forum of legal aid service providers and monitoring and evaluation of services.

comment.narrative: The new laws and strategies include CPEC LA strategy LA legislation etc

This indicator conflates together new laws and strategies developed adopted and rolled out to regions. As indicated in the assumption section of the log frame this outcome assumes approval processes which are beyond the sphere of control of the Ministry Of Justice will proceed smoothly. The values indicated in this current update relate only to those legislation that are tabled to the parliament for approval i.e1. Draft proclamation on Asset Recovery2. Draft proclamation on Criminal Procedure and Evidence Code.There are other legislation and strategies the grant supports as its targets under this outcome that are currently at draft level and going through internal reviews for finalization. These include1. Legal Aid strategy2. Legal Aid Legislation3. Draft Proclamation to provide for the Fundamental Requirements for Establishment and Recognition of Customary Courts in Ethiopia 4. Draft Criminal Law and Evidence Code roadmap and strategy.
